description: Shared definitions for com.minomobi.board — the spatial primitives an infinite canvas is made of. Nothing here is a record on its own; everything is embedded in a com.minomobi.board.canvas.

camera.description: Where the viewer was last looking. x/y is the world point at the top-left of the viewport; zoom is screen-pixels per world-unit.

zoom.description: Zoom × 1000, so it stays an integer. 1000 = 100%.

item.description: One thing placed on the canvas. Position and size are the SPATIAL data; `content` is the payload. Splitting them this way means a client can lay out a board it does not fully understand — an unknown content union member still has a known box.

id.description: Stable within the board. Edge endpoints and portal absorb/restore both key off it.

w.description: Width in world units. Omitted = client default for the content type.

z.description: Paint order, low to high. Ties broken by array order.

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise, about the item's centre.

tint.description: Named accent, not a hex colour — so a board re-themes with the client instead of freezing one palette into the repo.

label.description: Short caption shown under the item.

text.description: A text snip. Plain text with soft line breaks; no markup dialect is implied.

image.description: A picture, stored as a blob on the author's PDS.

audio.description: A voice note or clip. `peaks` lets a client draw the waveform without downloading and decoding the blob — the whole point of a board being scannable at a glance.

weblink.description: A link card. Title/description are captured at drop time so the card still reads after the target rots.

file.description: Any other media, kept whole as a blob.

portal.description: A whiteboard nested inside a whiteboard. `board` is an at-uri, NOT a strongRef: the target is mutable by design, and pinning a CID would make every child edit invalidate its parent.

count.description: Item count at last write — a hint for the parent's preview, not authoritative.

thumb.description: Optional rendered preview of the child.

frame.description: A labelled region. Purely visual grouping — items are not owned by the frame they sit in; spatial containment is the only relationship, which is what keeps the model flat and the geometry honest.

ink.description: Freehand strokes. Points are stored relative to the item box (0–1000 in each axis) so a stroke scales with its item and survives a resize.

points.description: Flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,…] in per-mille of the item box.

embed.description: Any ATProto record pinned to the canvas — a Bluesky post, a poll, another site's record. A strongRef here (unlike a portal) because the target is immutable content being quoted.

snapshot.description: Human-readable cache of the target at pin time, so the card renders offline.

edge.description: A connector between two items — the linking technology. `from`/`to` are item ids within the same board; an edge never crosses a board boundary (nesting re-points it at the portal instead).

bend.description: Curvature, per-cent of the chord length. 0 = straight.
